name: What are the advantages of a metal roof for my home?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of a metal roof for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Metal roofs offer durability, longevity, and can increase energy efficiency by reflecting solar radiant heat. They are resistant to fire, rot, and insects, often lasting 40-70 years with proper installation and maintenance. A practical tradeoff to consider is the initial cost, which is typically higher than asphalt shingles, but this is offset by reduced maintenance and longer lifespan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Metal roofs provide durability, longevity, and energy efficiency. They resist fire, rot, and insects, lasting decades.
